function toggleLang() {
  document.body.classList.toggle('cn');
  const btn = document.getElementById('lang-btn');
  btn.textContent = document.body.classList.contains('cn') ? 'EN' : '中文';
  localStorage.setItem('lang', document.body.classList.contains('cn') ? 'cn' : 'en');
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  if (localStorage.getItem('lang') === 'cn') {
    document.body.classList.add('cn');
    var btn = document.getElementById('lang-btn');
    if (btn) btn.textContent = 'EN';
  }
});

function openShinyApp() {
  var modal = document.getElementById('shiny-modal');
  modal.classList.add('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  var iframe = modal.querySelector('iframe');
  if (!iframe.src) iframe.src = 'https://guofang1028.shinyapps.io/ShinyApp/';
}
function closeShinyApp() {
  var modal = document.getElementById('shiny-modal');
  modal.classList.remove('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
</script>

<div class="poster-body">

<!-- ROW 1: Motivation | Dataset | Methodology -->
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:16px;">

<!-- Motivation & Objectives -->
<div class="section-card">
<h2>Motivation &amp; Objectives</h2>
<p style="margin-bottom:8px;">Colombia's fintech sector is growing rapidly, yet many institutions lack accessible tools to analyze customer behavior and predict churn. This project aims to:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">Democratize analytics</strong> &mdash; enable non-technical stakeholders to explore customer data through interactive visualizations</li>
<li><strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">Identify behavioral segments</strong> &mdash; uncover distinct customer groups via unsupervised clustering on transactional features</li>
<li><strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">Predict churn risk</strong> &mdash; build interpretable models that quantify churn probability and surface key drivers</li>
<li><strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">Enable what-if analysis</strong> &mdash; let decision-makers simulate interventions and assess impact on retention</li>
</ul>
<div style="margin-top:10px;padding:8px 12px;background:rgba(26,143,170,0.06);border-left:3px solid #1A8FAA;border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;">
<p style="font-size:10px;color:#1A8FAA;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px;">CORE QUESTION</p>
<p style="font-style:italic;color:#e2e8f0;">"How can interactive visual analytics help Colombian fintech institutions understand, segment, and retain their customers?"</p>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Dataset Overview -->
<div class="section-card">
<h2>Dataset Overview</h2>
<p style="margin-bottom:10px;">The <strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">COFINFAD</strong> (Colombian Fintech Financial Analytics Dataset) contains comprehensive customer and transaction records:</p>
<!-- KPI row -->
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;">
<div class="kpi-box">
<div class="kpi-val">48,723</div>
<div class="kpi-label">Customers</div>
</div>
<div class="kpi-box">
<div class="kpi-val">3.16M</div>
<div class="kpi-label">Transactions</div>
</div>
<div class="kpi-box">
<div class="kpi-val">54</div>
<div class="kpi-label">Variables</div>
</div>
</div>
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;">
<div class="kpi-box">
<div class="kpi-val">15</div>
<div class="kpi-label">Departments</div>
</div>
<div class="kpi-box">
<div class="kpi-val">12 mo</div>
<div class="kpi-label">Time Span (2023)</div>
</div>
</div>
<p style="margin-bottom:4px;"><strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">Customer table:</strong> demographics, income bracket, acquisition channel, churn probability, NPS, satisfaction score</p>
<p><strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">Transaction log:</strong> date, amount (COP), type (Transfer, Withdrawal, Payment, Deposit), behavioral metrics</p>
<!-- Mini chart: Colombia map placeholder -->
<div class="viz-placeholder chart-map" style="min-height:70px;">

<circle cx="58" cy="38" r="3.5" fill="#1A8FAA" opacity="0.6"/><circle cx="55" cy="26" r="1.8" fill="#1A8FAA" opacity="0.3"/>

</svg>

<!-- Methodology / Approach -->
<div class="section-card">
<h2>Methodology &amp; Approach</h2>
<p style="margin-bottom:8px;">We follow a <strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">5-stage analytical framework</strong> that progresses from exploration to actionable simulation:</p>
<!-- Flow diagram -->
<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;margin-bottom:10px;">
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">
<span style="background:#1A8FAA;color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:4px;">1</span>
<span style="font-size:10.5px;color:#e2e8f0;font-weight:600;">EXPLORE</span>
<span style="color:#4a6a8a;font-size:10px;">&mdash; EDA with interactive charts &amp; maps</span>
</div>
<div style="margin-left:14px;border-left:2px solid rgba(26,143,170,0.3);height:6px;"></div>
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">
<span style="background:#1A8FAA;color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:4px;">2</span>
<span style="font-size:10.5px;color:#e2e8f0;font-weight:600;">CONFIRM</span>
<span style="color:#4a6a8a;font-size:10px;">&mdash; Hypothesis testing via ggstatsplot</span>
</div>
<div style="margin-left:14px;border-left:2px solid rgba(26,143,170,0.3);height:6px;"></div>
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">

<!-- ROW 3: Key Findings | Discovered Segments | Conclusion & Future -->
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:16px;">

<!-- Key Findings -->
<div class="section-card">
<h2>Key Findings</h2>

<div class="finding-item">
<div class="finding-dot"></div>
<p><strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">Seasonal patterns differ by transaction type</strong> &mdash; Transfers peak mid-year while deposits show end-of-year spikes, confirmed by Kruskal-Wallis tests (p &lt; 0.001).</p>
</div>

<div class="finding-item">
<div class="finding-dot"></div>
<p><strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">Income brackets drive behavioral divergence</strong> &mdash; High-income customers average 3.2x more transaction volume than low-income segments, with significantly different product usage profiles.</p>
</div>

<div class="finding-item">
<div class="finding-dot"></div>
<p><strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">Geographic clustering of churn risk</strong> &mdash; Rural departments show 40% higher churn probability than urban centers like Bogot&aacute; and Medell&iacute;n, linked to limited product access.</p>
</div>

<div class="finding-item">
<div class="finding-dot"></div>
<p><strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">Satisfaction score is the #1 churn predictor</strong> &mdash; Lasso feature selection consistently ranks satisfaction_score as the strongest predictor, followed by customer_tenure and active_products.</p>
</div>

<div class="finding-item">
<div class="finding-dot"></div>
<p><strong style="color:#f0f4f8;">Product bundling reduces churn ~15%</strong> &mdash; What-if simulations show increasing active_products from 1 to 3 cuts predicted churn probability from ~47% to ~32%.</p>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Discovered Customer Segments -->
<div class="section-card">
<h2>Discovered Customer Segments</h2>
<p style="margin-bottom:10px;">Optimal clustering (k=4) reveals four distinct behavioral profiles across 10 engineered features:</p>

<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;">
<!-- Segment 1 -->
<div style="background:rgba(26,143,170,0.08);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-left:3px solid #1A8FAA;">
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
<span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#1A8FAA;">Power Users</span>
<span style="font-size:9px;color:#8aa3c8;">~18% of customers</span>
</div>
<p style="font-size:10px;margin-top:3px;">High frequency, high value, long tenure. Low churn risk. Cross-sell opportunities.</p>
</div>
<!-- Segment 2 -->
<div style="background:rgba(59,130,246,0.08);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-left:3px solid #3b82f6;">
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
<span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#3b82f6;">Regular Users</span>
<span style="font-size:9px;color:#8aa3c8;">~35% of customers</span>
</div>
<p style="font-size:10px;margin-top:3px;">Consistent activity, moderate values. Stable segment. Upsell potential via engagement.</p>
</div>
<!-- Segment 3 -->
<div style="background:rgba(16,185,129,0.08);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-left:3px solid #10b981;">
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
<span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#10b981;">Occasional Users</span>
<span style="font-size:9px;color:#8aa3c8;">~28% of customers</span>
</div>
<p style="font-size:10px;margin-top:3px;">Sporadic engagement, low product count. Respond well to targeted campaigns.</p>
</div>
<!-- Segment 4 -->
<div style="background:rgba(239,68,68,0.08);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-left:3px solid #ef4444;">
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
<span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#ef4444;">At-Risk / New Adopters</span>
<span style="font-size:9px;color:#8aa3c8;">~19% of customers</span>
</div>
<p style="font-size:10px;margin-top:3px;">Very low activity, short tenure, high churn probability. Priority for onboarding programs.</p>
</div>
</div>
